newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Energy begins Texas production.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Energy begins Texas production.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy Corp said Wednesday its Brown H-1 well in Washington County, Texas, began production March 30.

The single lateral horizontal Austin Chalk Well is producing at a daily rate of 100.3 million cubic feet of natural gas per day, Chesapeake said. It owns a 67-percent working interest in the well, while Belco Oil & Gas Corp owns a 30-percent stake.
Chesapeake said it has now drilled 77 horizontal wells deeper than 13,000 feet deep, more than any other horizontal driller.
The company is an independent energy producer.
Its shares were up 3/4 Wednesday at 22-3/4.
